description: This file defines utility functions and classes for security token management, Thunder plugin communication, and plugin activation within a C++ project. It includes security token retrieval via CURL, Thunder plugin client creation, and plugin service state management.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: A dispatchable job class that executes a provided function, with conditional inheritance based on USE_THUNDER_R4 macro.

methods.name: getSecurityToken
methods.description: Retrieves a security token, caching it for subsequent calls, and checks if Thunder security is configured.

methods.name: writeCurlResponse
methods.description: Callback for writing CURL response data into a string stream.

methods.name: isThunderSecurityConfigured
methods.description: Checks if Thunder security subsystem is configured by querying a local service endpoint.

methods.name: getThunderControllerClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a Thunder plugin client connection with security token authentication.

methods.name: getServiceState
methods.description: Queries the state of a plugin service via its callsign.

methods.name: activatePlugin
methods.description: Activates a plugin identified by its callsign asynchronously.
